findings.source_quote: The urgency of the last minute is something that many homemakers deal with regularly.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «Nødvendigheten av siste liten» with «Tidspresset i siste liten» to convey urgency rather than necessity.
findings.translation_quote: Nødvendigheten av siste liten er noe mange hjemmeværende ofte må forholde seg til.

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “When our children were young”
findings.source_quote: I was better able to cope with the last-minute rush if that job was out of the way.
findings.suggested_fix: Use «hastverket i siste liten» rather than «siste-liten-stresset» to retain the source’s reference to a rush.
findings.translation_quote: Jeg taklet siste-liten-stresset bedre hvis den oppgaven var unnagjort.
